description: Regenerates the suggested portfolio of one saved strategy with its saved settings, like Regenerate on acubic.ai, and returns the holdings and weights; the saved strategy is not changed. It never changes the ranking or the weighting: for another one, build with acubic_create_strategy. It counts against the same ranking and weighting attempt limit as the website.

strategy_id.description: The saved strategy whose suggested portfolio is regenerated.

suggestion_id.description: Read a suggestion still being computed (from a running result).

name: acubic_regenerate_suggestion

cash_seats.description: Seats a saved correlation limit left empty, held as cash.

correlation_limit.description: Present only when the saved correlation limit could not be met.

held.description: False: fewer names fit the limit than the seats asked for.

degraded.description: True when the saved filters could not be checked: they were not applied and the saved holdings were kept (rescreen.status unavailable).

dropped.description: Saved holdings left out of the suggestion.

status.description: Only when the saved filters could not be checked.

source.description: rescreen: the saved filters' re-screen; ranking: a fresh ranking; saved_names: the saved holdings re-weighted.

suggestion_id.description: While running: pass it back to read the suggestion.

title: Regenerate the suggested portfolio
